text:
deploybot: Deploy request queued for hotfix: redwood/inference:v2026.03.21-hotfix-513 -> staging. Planned canary 10% at 23:10 UTC. Please ack within 15m or deploy will wait. /deploy --canary=10% --timeout=20m
sara: acked. SRE will monitor metrics and paging. :thumbsup:
miguel: quick Q — what's the rollback criteria for this run?
sara: rollback if error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 600ms for 3m. following runbook section 3.2. tagging @oncall.
anya: @oncall fyi: this is the tokenizer KVCACHE OOM fix that caused embeddings failures under burst. low-risk but want fast cutover.
john: pasted a short log from staging reproducer: ```ERROR: kv_cache.cpp:142 OOM while allocating 64MB
stack: kv_cache::alloc -> embed_serv::handle -> main```
opsbot: Oncall rotation: now_oncall -> @kevin (SRE)
kevin: ack, I'm oncall. I'll keep dashboard open https://dash.redwood.internal/ops/hotfix-748888 and set a short-lived alert on error_rate and p95.
sara: we need expedited infra signoff to skip extended canary window — asking for +2 infra leads.
miguel: +1 from miguel (infra lead).
anya: +1 from anya (product) — release notes updated: "Fix KVCACHE OOM causing embedding failures under burst load"
john: scheduling a rolling restart on canary pods to pick up GC tuning in the image.
kevin: seeing CPU spike on canary nodes but error_rate 0.02% and p95 380ms. looks acceptable.
sara: recommend advancing to 50% traffic if infra + product signoffs present. need final ack to skip 2hr canary.
miguel: approve skip; proceed to 50% then full if no regressions in next 10m. +sig infra.
anya: approved +sig product.
kevin: I'll hold for a 10m observation window until 23:22 UTC.
sara: deploybot: begin canary roll (10%) at 23:12 UTC
deploybot: Canary started: pods staging-canary-{1..3}, image redwood/inference:v2026.03.21-hotfix-513
kevin: initial telemetry: error_rate 0.02%, p95 410ms. setting minor alert threshold.
sara: proceeding to 50% now?
miguel: go for 50%. document rollback image as redwood/inference:v2026.03.20-stable before proceeding.
sara: noted rollback image pinned. deploybot: canary -> 50% starting 23:20 UTC
deploybot: 50% complete, traffic shifted. metrics: error_rate 0.01%, p95 420ms
john: logs show kv cache GC frequency normalized after restart, no OOMs in last 6m.
kevin: still green. holding for remaining 4m of observation window.
sara: if green, cutover at 23:25 and annotate changelog.
deploybot: initiating full rollout 23:25 UTC
deploybot: rollout complete 23:28 UTC
kevin: monitoring post-rollout — no regressions detected, CPU settled, error_rate steady at 0.01%
sara: adding notes to release tracker and changelog: https://releases.redwood.internal/changes/2026-03-21-hotfix-513. Skipped extended canary per infra/product expedited approvals (+2).
lina: compliance noted the change window and audit entry created (ticket C-2026-031).
anya: thanks team — closing thread. :tada:
